name: Terrarium 30x30x30 +3D
label: Small terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 30x30x30 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 27.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: A cube with 30 cm sides: 900 cm² of floor, 30 cm of height and 27 liters of volume. Equal dimensions mean the terrarium is neither distinctly a floor model nor distinctly a tall one, so it is adapted through how you set it up. Inside is a 3D background that we shape by hand from styrofoam. Decorative film goes on three outer sides, and the front has sliding glass.

For a young leopard gecko, set it up low, with hides on the floor. For a young crested or day gecko, place branches diagonally and a plant near the top, so the whole height is used. A young corn snake uses both the floor and the background. Adults of these species need more space than 30 cm per side.

Taller models on the same base are the 30x30x40, 30x30x50 and 30x30x55, if you keep climbing species. For ground species the better next step is the 45x35x35. We also build larger cubes to order, with a build time of 7 to 14 days. We ship the 30 cm cube by courier, with film in the pattern you choose.
